## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (fp16, needs ~0.91 GB, from [huggingface.co/distil-whisper](https://huggingface.co/distil-whisper/distil-small.en))
   
   ```sh
   uv run --with transformers --with torch python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('automatic-speech-recognition', model='distil-whisper/distil-small.en')('audio.wav', return_timestamps=True)['text'])"
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/distil-whisper](https://huggingface.co/distil-whisper/distil-small.en)
